english.meaning: of a fruit, having a big stone
english.note: 大核 means big stone. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Yeah, but it’s not very big—not as big as a lychee. Anyway, it has a fairly large pit; the rest is medium-sized.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係啊，但係又唔係好大，又冇話懷枝咁大，總之𠻺大粒核，（）就中等噉喇。
